crossRefs.note: Let’s not become conceited, provoking one another, and envying one another.

translations.web: But if you bite and devour one another, be careful that you don’t consume one another.
translations.bsb: But if you keep on biting and devouring one another, watch out, or you will be consumed by one another.
translations.kjv: But if ye bite and devour one another, take heed that ye be not consumed one of another.
translations.asv: But if ye bite and devour one another, take heed that ye be not consumed one of another.
